newsitem.title: POLAND: TWO POLISH GARMENT FIRMS IN EXPORT JOINT-VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: TWO POLISH GARMENT FIRMS IN EXPORT JOINT-VENTURE.

text.p: Vistula, Wolczanka and a Polish consulting firm based in the Russian Kaliningrad enclave have set up a joint venture to sell garments to former Soviet countries, Vistula's president said.

Edward Robak told reporters during a break in the meeting of Vistula's board that the compny was now in talks on the purchase of a retail outlet in Kaliningrad. He declined to give any further details until the negotiations were concluded.
"We treat our presence in Kaliningrad as a foothold on the Eastern market," Robak said.
